project_type: Full-stack web application - Python FastAPI backend + React/TypeScript frontend
build_system: pip for backend, npm/vite for frontend, docker-compose for production
test_framework: pytest with httpx AsyncClient and SQLite test DB (backend), TypeScript compilation check (frontend)
build_command: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Install backend deps: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt. 2. Run backend tests: pytest tests/ -v. 3. Install frontend deps: cd frontend && npm install. 4. Build frontend: npm run build. 5. Verify backend starts: uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 (check /api/health responds).
setup_instructions: Backend: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt. Frontend: cd frontend && npm install.

key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI routers in app/routers/, SQLAlchemy models in app/models/, Pydantic schemas in app/schemas/, business logic in app/services/. RBAC via get_current_user and require_admin dependencies. Audit logging via log_audit() helper. Frontend: React pages in src/pages/, TanStack Query hooks in src/hooks/, shadcn/ui components, axios API client at src/lib/api.ts.
directory_structure: Root: docker-compose.yml, .env.example, README.md. backend/: FastAPI app in app/ with core/, models/, routers/, schemas/, services/, middleware/. alembic/ for migrations. tests/ for pytest. frontend/: React app in src/ with pages/, components/, hooks/, lib/. Dockerfile and nginx.conf for production.
